webmentions.content: Purelymail is even cheaper than Migadu an supports Email, Contacts and Calendars. I am very happy with them for the last few months since I switched.

As soon of you might know, I moved my e-mail to Migadu back in March. At the time I contacted the staff at Migadu about calendar and contacts support and I was told that it would be supported within two months. It’s been over two months and I tried to reach the support twice. No replies whatsoever.I might move to Fastmail.
